content: If the API SomeIpTp_Transmit() is called with a PDU ID which is currently used for an ongoing segmentation, • E_NOT_OK shall be returned. • The ongoing disassembly process for this PDU ID shall be canceled. • The API PduR_SomeIpTpTxConfirmation()with result set to E_NOT_OK shall be called. • The API Det_ReportRuntimeError() shall be called with the runtime error code SOMEIPTP_E_DISASSEMBLY_INTERRUPT.
